filter.sanctionTitle: Filter by official Burning Man Regional Event status

regionBar.filtered_one: Filtered to {{region}} — showing {{count}} burn. Every tab is scoped to this region.
regionBar.filtered_other: Filtered to {{region}} — showing {{count}} burns. Every tab is scoped to this region.

sanctionStrip.unmatched: {{count}} on official list with no active dust match

empty.noMatch: No burns match the current filter.

overview.topBurnsSub: Largest scheduled programs across the current filter. Click any bar to open its page.
overview.byRegionSub: Geographic spread. Click a slice to filter to just that region.
overview.typeMixSub: Summed across burns in current filter. The 19-label dust taxonomy.

moop.title: The MOOP Report
moop.sub: {{tiles}} trivia tiles across {{burns}} burns in current filter. Tiles with an → arrow open the relevant burn page.

burnDetail.notFoundSub: No festival with slug {{slug}} in the current dataset.
burnDetail.datesOnlyManual: Listed manually — schedule, camps and art aren’t published through a feed PlayaScope can read.
burnDetail.datesOnlyDirectory: Listed on the burningman.org directory — this burn doesn’t publish a Dust feed, so only its dates and location are known here.
burnDetail.noEvents: No scheduled events have been published yet for this burn.
burnDetail.scheduleShapeSub: Events per day of burn. Day 0 is opening day.
burnDetail.timeOfDaySub: When the events fire. Hour 0 is local midnight.
burnDetail.heatmap: Time of day × day of burn
burnDetail.heatmapSub: Darker = more events that hour/day. Shows the actual rhythm of the burn.
burnDetail.titleWordsSub: Words that recur across this burn's program.
burnDetail.performersSub: Top {{n}} by music-set count at this burn.
burnDetail.featuredArtSub: First 20 pieces. All on the playa for the burn's run ({{dates}}).

battle.title: Burn Battle
battle.sub: Pick two burns. Bigger number takes the round. Verdict is automatic and unkind. The URL updates so you can share a matchup.
battle.copyTitle: Copy a shareable link to this matchup
battle.sameError: A burn can't battle itself. Pick two different burns.
battle.fingerprintSub: How each burn's program splits across the 19 categories.
battle.scheduleShapeSub: Events per day of burn — Day 0 is opening day.

personality.title: Burn personality profiles
personality.sub: Each card scores its burn against the global baseline ({{n}} burns) on the 19-label dust taxonomy. Z-score > +0.5 becomes a trait; lowest z-score is the "doesn't really do" call-out. Click a card for similar burns.

artists.searchSub: Type any artist / DJ / performer name. Fuzzy match across all {{n}} performers indexed.
artists.noMatch: No match. Names come from music.json `occurrence.who`.
artists.leaderboardSub: Ranked by number of distinct burns. They will not sleep.
artists.collisionsSub: Same name appears at two burns within 24h — likely a data quirk, possibly a tour-de-force.

continuity.title: Year-over-year continuity
continuity.emptySub: No multi-year burns in the current filter. Most burns in dust.events only have a single year ({{total}} burns total, {{multi}} of those have ≥2 years).
continuity.trajectoriesSub: {{n}} burns have ≥2 years of data in dust.events. Lines show events / camps / art / music counts across years.
continuity.byPctChange: Top 10 by % change in event count.
continuity.debutSub: Burns in the latest year with no prior-year entry in dust.events.

calendar.title: Burn calendar — the season at a glance
calendar.sub: {{shown}} of {{total}} burns in view across {{regions}} regions. Click a bar to open the burn. Today line in white.

schedule.title: Schedule shape — events per day of burn
schedule.sub_one: X axis is days from the festival's local start (Day -1 = pre-burn, Day 0 = opening). Y axis is event count per day. Showing {{count}} burn.
schedule.sub_other: X axis is days from the festival's local start (Day -1 = pre-burn, Day 0 = opening). Y axis is event count per day. Showing {{count}} burns.
schedule.pickSub: Click to toggle on the chart. Shift-click (or use the arrow) to open the burn page. Empty selection = top 8 by event volume.
schedule.peakHour: Peak hour: {{hour}} — {{vibe}}. Hour 0 is midnight local time.

typeMix.title: Event-type mix per burn
typeMix.sub: Stacked: each bar is one burn, segments are the 19 dust event-type labels. {{n}} burns with scheduled events.
typeMix.heatmapSub: Same data, denser layout. Darker = larger share / count.

lexicon.title: Lexicon — what burners actually say
lexicon.sub: {{unique}} distinct {{units}}, {{occurrences}} total occurrences across {{scope}}. Bigger = more frequent.
lexicon.rankedSub: Same data, tabular — the Examples column shows where each term appears.

geo.worldMapSub: Circle size scaled to event count. {{n}} active burns. Click a marker for details.
geo.durationSub: How long burns run, in days.
geo.byRegionSub: Self-reported region string. Sorted by count.
